intelligence.essence: If somebody doesn't want the beautiful formatting, they can go into Settings and turn it off for their Naya notes or their posts — "unformat Naya notes" or "unformat posts". Unformatted means one elevated block, verbatim as inputted, no board separation every three or four sentences, no auto-organization. Formatted means we auto-organize and auto-format your content so it comes out beautifully. That's the difference — and it's your choice. One thing you can never turn off: a smart note. The public smart note stays formatted, always.
